DASHBOARD.TITLE: CamPulse - Cambodia's Premium Investment & Portfolio Tracker
DASHBOARD.SUBTITLE: A real-world professional ledger for active investors. Log transactions, track real-time asset prices, and automatically analyze matching lots using the LIFO cost basis logic.
DASHBOARD.FEATURE_PRICES_DESC: Public cached feed directly from the Cambodia Securities Exchange.
DASHBOARD.FEATURE_LIFO_DESC: Taxes and cost-basis matched against your most recent purchases first.
DASHBOARD.FEATURE_LEDGER_DESC: Permanent transaction history, with detailed commissions calculations.
DASHBOARD.CHART_PRINCIPAL_DESC: The blue line shows the cumulative cash capital you have tied up in stock purchases. It only goes up when you buy and down when you sell positions.
DASHBOARD.CHART_EQUITY_DESC: The green/red gradient line represents the current market value of your portfolio. It updates dynamically using real-time CSX stock quotes.
DASHBOARD.CHART_GAP_DESC: The gap between the lines is filled with a semi-transparent green highlight to show profit, giving you an instant visual of your investment efficiency since period start.
